integrity: Exact symbolic 256-input certificate and independent 65536-state graph enumeration were run. No external independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-graph classification only; no claim about all generalized Petersen or cubic graphs. Some historical priority comparisons are incomplete because original Goles–Olivos full text was inaccessible.
title: The Möbius–Kantor majority clock: twelve symbolic necklaces and six two-cycle basin sizes
